verdict.rationale: Ramp documents Funds as budgets with enforced restrictions: amount, interval, allowed merchants, categories and countries. Its spend-controls layer of budgets, templates and approval workflows applies to cards, reimbursements and bills, and spend limits and merchant blocks are enforced before spend happens. Cards can be scoped to individual teams, and approval workflows route by spend amount, team role or category, with request recommendations grounded in budgets. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of project-level (not just team-level) budget allocation and rollup, and independent or hands-on corroboration that enforcement works as described.
